newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Tuesday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade on Tuesday was active in the panhandle area early, but turning slow after mid- morning. Slaughter steers and heifers were $2.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reported good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 16,300 slaughter steers and 11,000 heifers; 48,400 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,000 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 68.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 66.00. Pen Utility to Choice 2-4 1150 lb cows and heiferettes 61.00.
Wk to date - 48,400 Week Ago - 81,600 Year Ago - 39,200
